user.title: Sign in to mijnTED
user.description: Use the e-mail address and password you use on mijnted.nl.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your mijnTED account.
data_description.password: The password of your mijnTED account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to mijnTED again
reauth_confirm.description: mijnTED rejected the password for {email}. Enter the current password.

data_description.password: The password of your mijnTED account.

reconfigure.title: Change mijnTED sign-in
reconfigure.description: Change the e-mail address or password. It must stay the same mijnTED account.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your mijnTED account.
data_description.password: The password of your mijnTED account.

error.invalid_auth: mijnTED rejected the e-mail address or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach mijnTED. Try again later.
error.unexpected_page: mijnTED showed a sign-in step this integration does not support, such as multi-factor authentication or a captcha. Sign in once on mijnted.nl in a browser, then try again.
error.no_residential_units: This mijnTED account has no residential units with meters.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This mijnTED account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different mijnTED account.

data_description.update_interval: Hours between updates. mijnTED is updated about once a day.

unexpected_page.message: mijnTED showed an unsupported sign-in page at step {step}. Updates are paused until the integration is reloaded.

cannot_connect.message: Could not fetch data from mijnTED: {error}

unexpected_sign_in_page.title: mijnTED sign-in needs attention
unexpected_sign_in_page.description: Signing in to mijnTED for {title} stopped at an unsupported page (step: {step}). This happens with multi-factor authentication, a captcha, new terms of use or a changed sign-in page. Sign in on mijnted.nl in a browser and complete any extra step, then reload the integration. Updates are paused until then.

export_disabled.title: mijnTED meter export is off
export_disabled.description: mijnTED does not offer daily meter values for apartment {apartment}. Its meters are skipped until the export is turned on in the portal.
